title: Hosting Friends for After-Work Drinks
meta: B2 · 约 250 词 · 场景：订位、点单与核对账单

lines.en: Good afternoon, Copper Room. How can I help?
lines.zh: 下午好，这里是 Copper Room。有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: **Hi, I'd like to book a table for six this Thursday, around six thirty.**
lines.zh: 你好，我想订这周四的位子，六个人，六点半左右。

lines.en: Let me see. I can give you a high table near the window. Is that alright?
lines.zh: 我看看。可以给您安排靠窗的高桌，行吗？

lines.en: Perfect. Do you have a ==happy hour==, and __until what time__?
lines.zh: 太好了。你们有欢乐时段吗？到几点？

lines.en: Yes, until eight. House pours and draught beers are one-for-one.
lines.zh: 有，到八点。店酒和生啤买一送一。

lines.en: Great. One of my friends doesn't drink. Do you have decent ==mocktails==?
lines.zh: 很好。我有个朋友不喝酒，你们有像样的无酒精鸡尾酒吗？

lines.en: We have three on the menu, and the bartender can make something ==off menu== too.
lines.zh: 菜单上有三款，调酒师也可以做菜单外的。

lines.en: Good to know. Could we also __pre-order__ some ==bar snacks== so they're ready when we arrive?
lines.zh: 好的。我们能不能先预点一些下酒小吃，到的时候就能上？

lines.en: Of course. I'd suggest the sharing platter. It __feeds about__ four to six people.
lines.zh: 当然。推荐拼盘，大概够四到六个人吃。

lines.en: Let's do one platter. The booking is under Lee. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: 那就来一份拼盘。订位名字写 Lee。多谢。

lines.en: Excuse me, could we __get the bill__, please? It's all on one card.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，麻烦买单。全部刷一张卡。

lines.en: Certainly. Here you are. Take your time.
Sorry, I think there's a ==mistake==. We only had one bottle of white wine, but there are two on here.
lines.zh: 不好意思，好像有点问题。我们只点了一瓶白葡萄酒，账单上是两瓶。

lines.en: Let me check with the bar. You're right, the second one was for the next table. I'll take it off.
lines.zh: 我跟吧台确认一下。您说得对，第二瓶是隔壁桌的。我给您去掉。

lines.en: Thanks. And the beers after eight, were those still at the happy hour price?
lines.zh: 谢谢。还有八点以后点的啤酒，还算欢乐时段价吗？

lines.en: The last ==round== came in at eight ten, so that's full price, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 最后一轮是八点十分下的单，所以恐怕要按原价算。

lines.en: **Fair enough. Is the service charge already included?**
lines.zh: 也合理。服务费已经包含在内了吗？

lines.en: Yes, service charge and GST are both included. Your new ==total== is three hundred and twelve.
lines.zh: 是的，服务费和消费税都包含了。新的总额是三百一十二。

lines.en: **Great, thanks for sorting that out. We had a really good time.**
lines.zh: 好，谢谢你们处理。我们今晚玩得很开心。

gist.q: 「你」订了什么样的位子？还提前安排了什么？
gist.a: 周四六点半、六个人的靠窗高桌；还预点了一份分享拼盘。
多算了一瓶白葡萄酒，那瓶其实是隔壁桌的，经理去掉了。

gist.q: 为什么最后一轮啤酒按原价算？
gist.a: 因为是八点十分下的单，欢乐时段八点已经结束了。

prompts.q: 你想给团队在酒吧包一个角落办欢送会，大约十二个人。打电话问能不能预留、有没有最低消费、可不可以带蛋糕。
prompts.ref: Hi, I'm organising a farewell for a colleague next Friday evening, about twelve people. Would it be possible to reserve a corner area for us from seven? Is there a minimum spend for a group that size? Also, we'd like to bring our own cake. Is that okay, and is there a cake cutting fee?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我下周五晚上要给同事办个欢送会，大概十二个人。七点开始能给我们预留一个角落吗？这么多人有没有最低消费？另外我们想自带蛋糕，可以吗？收切蛋糕费吗？

prompts.q: 结账时朋友坚持要和你平摊，但你说好今天你请。礼貌地坚持由你买单，并顺便约下次。
prompts.ref: No, no, put your card away. I invited you all tonight, so this one's on me. It's been ages since we got together, and I really wanted to say thanks for helping me settle in. If you insist, you can get the next round next time. Let's not leave it so long again.
prompts.ref_zh: 不不，把卡收起来。今晚是我请大家的，这顿我来。我们好久没聚了，我也一直想谢谢你们帮我适应这边。你们非要请的话，下次那一轮你们来。下次别隔这么久了。
